method: Chromium through TLS-verifying curl transport. Normal mode reuses static responses in the transport cache; no-cache bypasses that cache and sends Cache-Control/Pragma plus CDP cache disable. Browser HTTP cache itself is disabled by request routing. Document HTML is never cached by this transport.
note: These elapsed times show ordering, not a controlled speed benchmark. first page is the 128 product; next document is reached by a real related-product link click.
